extraction_notes: SI Figure S9 and SI Figure S12 were digitised as plotted catalytic-performance data. SI Figure S12 appears to repeat the Cu/Al2O3-HT and Cu/Al2O3-CP conversion/STY subsets from SI Figure S9 and is still reported as plotted data from its own panels. SI Figure S10 panels a-c show calculated TOF values, but the requested output schema has no TOF field; panels d-f are Arrhenius plots and were skipped under the figure rules. Characterisation/DRIFTS figures were skipped.
